name: No Factory Passengers
summary: The line editor no longer turns on passenger loading at stations that only serve an industry.
description: The line editor no longer turns on passenger loading at stops whose station only serves an industry. On a factory line, docks and other stops without homes in reach are left off too. Stations that also reach homes keep passengers.
